gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent or refractory glioblastoma with measurable disease at enrollment.

candidate_evidence.quote: BP102 is an autologous B7-H3 CAR-T cell product manufactured from the participant's peripheral blood mononuclear cells.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Recurrent or refractory glioblastoma with measurable disease at enrollment.

role_evidence.quote: BP102 is an investigational autologous B7-H3 CAR-T cell therapy manufactured from each patient's peripheral blood mononuclear cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous B7-H3-directed CAR-T cell therapy (BP102), intracranial via Ommaya reservoir
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: B7-H3 CAR-T cells are designed to recognize B7-H3 expressed on glioblastoma cells.

source_quote.quote: Available tumor tissue must be submitted for central laboratory analysis of B7-H3 expression.

coder_notes: Only intervention is a CAR-T cell therapy (registered as DRUG) -> excluded intervention type at S6. B7-H3 tissue must be submitted for analysis but positivity is not stated as an entry requirement, so coded exploratory_correlative; B7-H3 is the CAR-T target, but CAR-T is not a candidate, so not candidate_matched. CSF PK (Cmax/AUC of CAR-T in CSF) and CSF cytokine PD are planned, but for the excluded cell therapy, not a pharmacological candidate; tumour_pk_planned and target_engagement_planned coded no on that basis.
